name: Shortcuts.design
summary: Searchable reference of keyboard shortcuts for design, development, productivity and 3D tools.
description: A shortcut reference for designers: pick a tool — Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, Sketch, Framer, After Effects, Miro, Zeplin, Android Studio and more — and browse its Mac and Windows shortcuts, or search within a tool's list. Tools are grouped into design, development, productivity and 3D; missing shortcuts can be added via GitHub.
contains: Mac and Windows shortcut tables for 20+ design tools
per-tool search with a missing-shortcut fallback
shortcuts can be edited or added via GitHub
sponsor-supported, with a monthly update email
